main_constructions.name: KomorebiSpace.ViewSystem.relativeViewEquivalence
main_constructions.claim: Bijection of actual prescribed section extensions under equivalent views and an isomorphism-closed prescribed domain.

main_constructions.name: KomorebiSpace.GroupViewSystem.invisibleViewEquivalence
main_constructions.claim: Multiplicative equivalence of actual invisible coherent change groups.

main_constructions.name: KomorebiSpace.MarkedRealization.transportEquivalence
main_constructions.claim: Equivalence of identified-boundary groupoids induced by an explicitly weakly commuting square with equivalences horizontally.

main_constructions.name: KomorebiSpace.GroupViewSystem.relativeCocycleEquivalence
main_constructions.claim: Instantiation on actual Komorebi patch restriction and pullback functors, for saturated boundary and ambient patches.

main_constructions.name: KomorebiSpace.FramingBoundaryExamples.full_framing_not_equivalence
main_constructions.claim: Actual fully framed pullback can fail to be an equivalence even for saturated full domains and equivalent view categories.

non_claims: No invariance of all old based-gauge orbit sets.
No isomorphism of all old raw additive obstruction quotients.
No normed stability, arbitrary view-doctrine, infinity-stack, or arithmetic correspondence theorem.
No standard bicategorical universal-property or relative stack-pseudonaturality packaging beyond the proved explicit groupoids and functors.
